prompt: Move box1 to the table with arm1, then send channel "ops" a message saying how many seconds the job took, as measured by the program itself.

paths.when: the box is moved and the elapsed time is sent

world_1_5.note: no clock: `elapsed` needs none (0042 T7), so this is a program

why: The time the job took is `measure r elapsed as took;` after the last step, sent as the binding (0042 T1, T8). `elapsed` needs no clock: the world copy has none.
